patches.replace: larger budgets could find better architectures at the cost of search time. \emph{Capacity is not the constraint.} Across five mutually exclusive parameter bands the average AUROC moves by only 1.7 points and not one pairwise comparison is significant (Section~\ref{subsec:capacity}), so the framework has a fixed accuracy envelope near 83\% on MVTec-AD. The gap to CFA (89.8\%) and EfficientAD (97.5\%) therefore cannot be closed by allocating more parameters; it requires a different detection or search objective, which we regard as the central open problem for this line of work. \emph{The proxy metric is the binding constraint.}
